prompt: The cramped interior of an ambulance, filmed from a fixed point high in the front corner of the ceiling, looking down the length of the vehicle. Brandon lies on the stretcher on the right of the frame, his skin red and shiny and peeling, his brows drawn together and his eyelids half closed, his mouth hanging open. Sophie sits on the left of the frame on a fold-down seat beside him with a thick paper file open on her knee, smiling warmly at him, her brows lifted, her eyes crinkled and her head tilted. A pale strip light runs along the ceiling and the cabin walls are pale grey with stowed equipment bags, and an orange glow comes from the rear window. Muted, washed-out colour with faint grain. Thanks.
